metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - Under the weather, iffy for TNF
metadata.description: Mingo did not practice Wednesday due to an illness and is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers, Tommy Yarrish of the Cowboys' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Wednesday was the first time this week that Mingo popped up on the injury report, which casts uncertainty over his status for Thursday Night Football. He's seen just three targets through four regular-season games, but if Mingo isn't cleared to play, then undrafted rookie Camden Brown would be in line to be on the active gameday roster for the first time this season, with Ryan Flournoy and KaVontae Turpin both in the mix for a slight increase in offensive snaps.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo (illness) listed questionable Thursday
metadata.description: Jonathan Mingo is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against the Buccaneers.
metadata.analysis: Mingo remains off the fantasy radar if he is cleared.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - Catches sole target in loss
metadata.description: Mingo caught his sole target for 10 yards in Sunday's 28-20 loss to the Giants.
metadata.analysis: Mingo played 11 of 58 offensive snaps and six special teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The wide receiver seems to be getting mixed in on snaps when CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens or Ryan Flournoy need a break. Mingo remains the fifth option for the Cowboys wide receiver corps and will likely continue to see minimal opportunities in a highly competitive room.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - Healthy for training camp
metadata.description: Mingo had a good first training camp session, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.
metadata.analysis: Mingo has been dealing with a minor groin strain since early June. The wide receiver has finally recovered from the issue and is all set to perform at his best in training camp for a chance to move up the Cowboys' depth chart. Mingo will need to outshine Marquez Valdes-Scantling, KaVontae Turpin and Ryan Flournoy for a chance at high-value snaps during the 2026 season.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - Dealing with groin strain
metadata.description: Coach Brian Schottenheimer said Tuesday that Mingo is tending to a minor groin strain, Jon Machota of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: There was no indication as to when Mingo suffered the injury, but it doesn't sound like it's a serious issue. Any time that Mingo potentially misses could turn into a small opportunity for Tyler Johnson to make a bigger impression outside.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo reworks contract with Cowboys
metadata.description: The Cowboys restructured the contract of WR Jonathan Mingo.
metadata.analysis: Dallas removed the $812k workout bonus Mingo had from his deal that was signed when he was drafted by Carolina in the second round. He is on the books for $1.145 million in 2026 for Dallas.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - Fails to make impact in 2025
metadata.description: Mingo caught one of five targets for 25 yards while active for six games with the Cowboys in 2025.
metadata.analysis: The third-year wideout didn't see his first snap of the season until Week 12, and he saw exactly one target in each of Dallas' last five games, catching just one of them. Mingo has one year left on his rookie contract after entering the league as a second-round pick of the Panthers in 2023, but he's done nothing with the Cowboys to suggest a breakout is coming next season, and he may not even be guaranteed a roster spot.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo sees one target in Week 17
metadata.description: Jonathan Mingo failed to catch his only target in the Cowboys' 30-23 win over the Commanders in Week 17.
metadata.analysis: Mingo has seen minimal involvement in the Dallas offense, recording one target or less in each of his five games. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 18 contest against the New York Giants.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - Could have bigger role Thursday
metadata.description: Mingo is not among Dallas' inactives for Thursday's Week 17 game against the Commanders, per Todd Archer of ESPN.com, and he could see an increased role with Ryan Flournoy (knee) out of action.
metadata.analysis: Mingo has had a quiet season so far, tallying one catch on three targets for 25 yards over four games. He'll still be behind CeeDee Lamb, George Pickens and KaVontae Turpin in the WR pecking order Thursday, but Mingo could get a few more looks due to Flournoy's absence. Mingo has been a bit more involved of late anyway, notching 14 offensive snaps Week 15 and eight offensive snaps last Sunday against the Chargers.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - First catch of season
metadata.description: Mingo caught his only target for a 25-yard gain in Sunday's 34-26 loss to the Vikings.
metadata.analysis: His first catch of the season came on the Cowboys' final drive, helping to set up a Brandon Aubrey field goal that got the home side to within a score, but they couldn't recover the subsequent onside kick. Mingo has seen only two targets in three games since making his 2025 debut in Week 12, and it would likely take a rash of injuries ahead of him on the depth chart to get him on the fantasy radar.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - Ready to go for TNF
metadata.description: Mingo is active for Thursday night's matchup with the Lions.
metadata.analysis: Mingo will be active for just the second time this season, suiting up in place of Jalen Tolbert (coach's decision) against Detroit. Mingo has played just three snaps on offense this year, failing to garner a target. He'll operate behind Ceedee Lamb, George Pickens, Ryan Flournoy and KaVontae Turpin in Week 14.

metadata.title: Jonathan Mingo - Healthy scratch Thanksgiving Day
metadata.description: Mingo (coach's decision) is inactive for Thursday's game against the Chiefs, Nick Harris of the Fort Worth Star-Telegram reports.
metadata.analysis: Mingo has consistently been a healthy scratch since returning from IR late October, as his first game being listed as active came Week 12 versus the Eagles. With Jalen Tolbert now back in the lineup versus Kansas City, however, Mingo reverts to his usual role. His next chance to suit up will come Thursday, Dec. 4 versus the Lions in Week 14.
